title: 30 MIN FULL BODY HIIT
description: A 30-minute, low-impact full-body interval workout reconstructed from MadFit's coached video.
notes: Thirty intervals: 40 seconds work and 20 seconds rest; no repeats and no jumping.
Exercise matches were reconstructed from the video's spoken transcript and compared with the bundled WorkoutX catalog.
The shared block can be composed into longer routines without duplicating its intervals.
